subtasks.text: Explain why soil needs to be loosened before cultivation.

guidance_text: GLOBAL_SUMMARY:
Before plowing hard soil, watering the soil is necessary to make it more workable and reduce dust. This process ensures the soil is in optimal condition for the next steps in crop production.

- The robot needs to have sensors to detect the moisture level of the soil.
